# Collectron: Emergency Technician Repair Bot

__Emergency Technician Repair Bot__

*"Every good C.A.M.P. needs their own Emergency Technician Repair Bot to keep things booming!"*

__Overview__

The Emergency Technician Repair Bot Station restores health to damaged C.A.M.P. objects over time.

When a camp item takes damage and its health bar is reduced, the bot will automatically repair the item, gradually restoring the lost health to the bar.

However, it will not repair items that have been completely destroyed, whether by players or NPC enemies.

__Function__

Repairs damaged C.A.M.P. items at a rate of 2% per hour. Does not repair destroyed items.

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 5

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: N/A

__How to Unlock__

Atom Shop:

- Emergency Technician Repair Bot Station: X Atoms
- X Bundle: X Atoms *(includes Emergency Technician Repair Bot Station)*
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Guides:

- __How to request items from the Atom Shop__
- Note: Not all items are currently available to request

__Build Restrictions__

- Shares Build Limit With: All other Repair Bots
- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
